shots.title: First impact
shots.description:
## Intent

Make the first impact turn @basilica-nave from sanctuary into exposed structure.

## Composition & Blocking

Hold @congregation across the nave as dust falls from the ceiling and everyone turns toward the shattered windows.

## Camera & Optics

Keep a **Wide Shot** at **Eye-Level** on a **24mm lens** with **Deep Focus**. The camera remains **Static** through the turn.

## Lighting

Hard side light from the breach catches the airborne dust.

## End Condition

End when @congregation faces the shattered windows.

optics.intent: Deep spatial clarity across the nave

lighting.intent: Hard side light through dust from the breach
